info.title: OpenCatalogi
info.description:
OpenCatalogi's public, anonymously-reachable API surface: full-text search, catalog and publication read access, DCAT-AP-NL and schema.org harvest feeds, DIWOO sitemaps/robots.txt, the federation read surface, the federated-directory sync endpoint, and the CMS read APIs (pages/menus/themes/glossary/listings). Every path in this document corresponds to a route in `appinfo/routes.php` whose controller method carries `@PublicPage` / `#[PublicPage]` — admin-gated and authenticated-only endpoints (settings, retention, Woo batches, setup, OOAPI 5.0 resource reads, DCAT/DIWOO/OOAPI validation reports) are out of scope; see the `public-api-openapi-document` OpenSpec change.

Every path is served under `/api/v1/`, the version this document describes. The unversioned `/api/` paths keep working, are deprecated, and name their `/api/v1/` successor in a `Link` header next to a `Deprecation` header. Paths that implement an external standard (DCAT-AP, OOAPI, schema.org, sitemaps, robots.txt, Atom feeds, federation) keep their own URLs and formats; openapi.standards.json describes them.

SelfMeta.description: OpenRegister object metadata. The exact property set is register/schema dependent and MUST NOT be frozen here — additionalProperties covers it.

ObjectRecord.description: A single register-defined object (publication, document, catalog, page, menu, theme, glossary term, listing, …). Properties beyond `@self` are defined by the instance's configured schema and are intentionally NOT frozen in this document (design decision D3) — additionalProperties: true.

total.description: Total matching objects across all pages.

facets.description: Facet counts, present when `_facets` was requested.

SearchEnvelope.description: Public full-text search result envelope (WOO-506). Flat mix of publication and document rows, discriminated by `@self.schema`.

CatalogPublicationsEnvelope.description: PaginatedEnvelope plus catalog-scoping metadata added by PublicationsController::index — `@catalog` (slug/title/schemas/registers) and resolved schema/register objects merged into `@self`.

DirectoryListEnvelope.description: Combined local + known-peer directory listing data.

WithheldEntry.description: A document withheld from publication: its position in the publication and the grounds, never its content (REQ-PDP-004, REQ-WDW-003).

position.description: Position of the document in the publication, from 1.

article.description: Empty when the code could not be resolved; never guessed.

label.description: Empty when the code could not be resolved; never guessed.

title.description: Only on an entry from a publication batch whose assessment has titlePublic true.

withheld.description: Present only when the catalogue (on the federation route: every catalogue holding the publication) has showWithheld true and the list could be read and holds at least one entry; absent otherwise, including when nothing was recorded for the publication.

Problem.description: RFC 9457 problem details. The members the endpoint returned before, `error` and `message`, are kept.

type.description: A URI that identifies the problem type.

title.description: The HTTP reason phrase of the status.

detail.description: What went wrong, for this occurrence.

changed.description: DCAT dataset nodes (JSON-LD) of the publications changed in the window.

withdrawn.description: Publications withdrawn in the window. Id and date only.

until.description: The moment of the read. Use it as the next `since`.

next.description: The next page, or null on the last.

SearchParam.name: _search
SearchParam.description: Free-text search term applied across the scoped schema(s).

ExtendParam.name: _extend
ExtendParam.description: Comma-separated list (or repeated param) of relations to expand inline. Sanitised server-side on the public surface — anonymous callers cannot traverse to unrelated objects via arbitrary extend targets.

FacetsParam.name: _facets
FacetsParam.description: Facet request, e.g. `_facets[@self][register]=true`. Object shape mirrors OpenRegister's facet-query dialect; additionalProperties covers the nested keys.

ContentParam.name: _content
ContentParam.description: Opt-in (default false): widen full-text search to OR-extracted document body text in addition to metadata (WOO-517).

EmptyParam.name: _empty
EmptyParam.description: When true, keep empty-valued properties in results instead of stripping them.

AccessControlAllowOrigin.description: CORS allowed origin (`*` unless an allowlist is configured).

APIVersion.description: The version of the API that answered, which is the installed app version.

NotFound.description: The requested resource does not exist.

ServiceUnavailable.description: The search/data backend (OpenRegister) is not installed or not configured.

Serves this static document with `info.version` substituted at serve time from the installed app version (`IAppManager::getAppVersion('opencatalogi')`) and CORS headers, same posture as the rest of the public surface.

Anonymous-reachable full-text search across publications and documents (WOO-506). Metadata matching always runs; pass `_content=true` to also match OR-extracted document body text (WOO-517). Only publicly-visible rows are ever returned, regardless of caller identity. Property filters are forwarded to OpenRegister: `documentType=minutes` and `bodyName=Gemeenteraad` match exactly, and `meetingDate[gte]` / `meetingDate[lte]` select a date range, both ends included. A range bound that is not a date or a number answers 400 and names the parameter.

parameters.description: Council documents: agenda, decision, minutes or activity.

parameters.name: bodyName
parameters.description: Council documents: the name of the council or committee.

parameters.name: meetingDate[gte]
parameters.description: Council documents: meetings on or after this date.

parameters.name: meetingDate[lte]
parameters.description: Council documents: meetings on or before this date.

400.description: A range bound is not a date or a number.

get.summary: What changed in a catalog since a moment
get.description: For a re-user who keeps a copy of a catalog. Lists the publications an anonymous visitor may read whose last change is at or after `since`, as DCAT dataset nodes ordered by last change and then id, and the publications withdrawn since then by id and date only. A withdrawn publication is listed only when a depublication record shows it was public once. Use `until` as the next `since`. Pages hold at most 100 entries; follow `next` while it is set.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: An ISO 8601 date or date and time, such as 2026-04-01T00:00:00Z.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The cursor of a next page, as `next` carries it.

400.description: `since` or `cursor` cannot be read; `parameter` names which.

The state of every component this instance reports on. A component nobody has touched inside the staleness window is marked stale rather than reported as fine, so an unattended page cannot read as a confident green.

post.description: Search what is actively published, without an account. The search runs over the anonymous permission set and no further, so a property a rule withholds is not searchable and not returned.

get.description: The documents that lie open for inspection, for whoever holds the link. The window is checked at the read, not by a job, so a link stops working the moment the statutory period ends. A closed window answers 410 with its end date, so a reader learns the period is over rather than that something is broken.

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: The unguessable part of the link.

200.description: The chosen documents and the window.

410.description: The inspection period for these documents has ended.

get.description: The state of a comment period, its legal remedy, its reaction form and its official announcement. The state is derived at the read rather than stored, so a scheduler that has not fired yet cannot leave a closed period inviting comment. The reaction form is answered only while the period is open.

200.description: The period, with one of the three states: upcoming, open or closed.

get.description: The public request catalogue: every service a resident or a company can ask for, grouped as the catalogue groups them. An entry whose case type cannot be read is counted as unavailable rather than left out, so a short list is never mistaken for a complete one.
